research_scope: Existing-meaning resolution after self-reference removal; specific commutative unital Noetherian local ring context.

resolutions.review_rationale: The sole remaining m-primary candidate is the ideal condition used by a system of parameters in a Noetherian local ring. Its generated ideal I is m-primary exactly when radical(I)=m. The existing ideal-of-definition formulation defines this same predicate in that context; the radical criterion gives a noncircular definition, after its own redundant candidate reference has been retired with provenance intact. Distinct concepts of system of parameters and selecting dimension-many generators are preserved without being identified.
